summary: Full backend + frontend testing for Vineet Events Creations. All 10 pytest backend tests pass (auth, enquiry CRUD, admin protected routes, stats, chatbot via Gemini 3 Flash). Frontend flows verified end-to-end: hero inline enquiry, header modal enquiry (both show enquiry-success + confetti), chatbot returns Gemini reply (~12s), navigation across all 8 pages, Services tab switching + Enquire Now modal, Artist & Events gallery filters + lightbox, Blog card -> article detail, Contact FAQ toggles, draggable WhatsApp button visible with correct number 97471913089, Admin protected route redirects to /admin, admin login succeeds with admin@vineetevents.com/Admin@123 and lands on /admin/dashboard with KPI cards, search, status filter, status change (toast confirmation), delete buttons, export CSV, logout. No blocking issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py handles CORS with allow_credentials=True but ADMIN_PASSWORD/JWT_SECRET are hardcoded in .env (expected for preview).
Chatbot messages have no per-message data-testid; only the window has one. Consider adding data-testid on message bubbles to make individual reply assertions easier for automated tests.
server.py 260 lines is fine; startup event uses deprecated @app.on_event (FastAPI now recommends lifespan). Non-blocking.
get_current_user uses ObjectId(payload['sub']); if token payload sub is not a valid ObjectId it raises unhandled -> would be 500. Consider try/except InvalidId -> 401.
seed_data_creation: Created ephemeral TEST_ enquiries via API and UI; all cleaned up post-run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (10 tests). All data-testid selectors mentioned in the review request are present and functional. WhatsApp button is a <button> (not an <a>) that opens wa.me on click via window.open - href attribute is null, verify via BUSINESS.whatsapp constant in /app/frontend/src/data/content.js (='97471913089'). Chatbot uses Gemini 3 Flash and typically replies in 8-15s.
